value.rationale: The distinguished module scalar t produces a natural nontrivial quadratic fiber in an entire family of finite endomorphism rings. The exact rank/cubic-rank type counts classify individual solutions beyond orbit existence, while the independent nondegenerate limiting defect distributions and explicit convergence rate resolve the typical behavior as multiplicities grow. This is a structurally motivated asymptotic, not an arbitrary finite slice or a trivial restatement of root existence.
